Cowboys vs Eagles DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, October 26 · NFL Week 7 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 7:35 PM ET

CeeDee Lamb has the highest SPAGS projection in the Cowboys at Eagles DraftKings Showdown: 18.6 points at $11,000 FLEX, 27.8 at captain for $16,500. Across 100,000 simulations Lamb holds 59% of the winning-lineup credit. Dak Prescott holds the most, at 68%. The case against Lamb is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 5.4 points at an $11,000 FLEX salary, in a game with a 43.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 18.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Lamb at captain. Javonte Williams is the next captain in line, at 13.8%. The model gives him 16.9 carries and 2.7 targets.

Dallas is a 4.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24 for the Cowboys and 19.5 for the Eagles.

Behind Lamb and Williams, the next projections are Dak Prescott (18.1, $10,400), Tanner McKee (14.4, $8,600) and George Pickens (14.0, $9,000).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 7:35 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: CeeDee Lamb, DAL WR ($11,000 FLEX / $16,500 CPT)

CeeDee Lamb holds 18.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $16,500 and the 18.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.8 targets on 36.2 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Lamb averaged 18.6 points with a simulated floor of 5.4 and a ceiling of 42.2. He holds 59% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 18.5% as the captain and 40.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Javonte Williams, DAL RB ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

Javonte Williams holds 13.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,900 and the 16.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 16.9 carries and 2.7 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Williams averaged 16.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.2 and a ceiling of 34.0. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.8% as the captain and 38.9% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Dak Prescott, DAL QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Dak Prescott holds 13.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 18.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Prescott averaged 18.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.1 and a ceiling of 36.9. He holds 68% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.1% as the captain and 54.8% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Cowboys vs Eagles

Tanner McKee, PHI QB ($8,600 FLEX / $12,900 CPT)

Tanner McKee carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 14.4 DraftKings points for an $8,600 FLEX salary ($12,900 at captain). Across 100,000 simulations McKee averaged 14.4 points with a simulated floor of 4.5 and a ceiling of 28.9. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.4% as the captain and 45.5% in a FLEX spot.

George Pickens, DAL WR ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

George Pickens carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 14.0 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). The model gives him 7.2 targets on 37.1 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Pickens averaged 14.0 points with a simulated floor of 1.7 and a ceiling of 38.0. He holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.9% as the captain and 27.6% in a FLEX spot.

Saquon Barkley, PHI RB ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Saquon Barkley carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.9 DraftKings points for a $9,600 FLEX salary ($14,400 at captain). The model gives him 11.8 carries and 2.0 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Barkley averaged 13.8 points with a simulated floor of 3.5 and a ceiling of 33.1. He holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.4% as the captain and 32.5% in a FLEX spot.

Dallas Goedert, PHI TE ($6,400 FLEX / $9,600 CPT)

Dallas Goedert carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.2 DraftKings points for a $6,400 FLEX salary ($9,600 at captain). The model gives him 6.1 targets on 21.0 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Goedert averaged 12.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.6 and a ceiling of 28.1. He holds 45% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.7% as the captain and 36.8% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Darius Cooper, PHI WR ($3,200 FLEX / $4,800 CPT)

Darius Cooper projects for 8.4 DraftKings points at a $3,200 FLEX salary, 2.62 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 3.1 targets on 16.2 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Cooper averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 1.4 and a ceiling of 20.7. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.4% as the captain and 29.1% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Makai Lemon, PHI WR ($3,800 FLEX / $5,700 CPT)

Makai Lemon projects for 9.4 DraftKings points at a $3,800 FLEX salary, 2.48 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 6.2 targets on 32.1 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Lemon averaged 9.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.4 and a ceiling of 21.3. He holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.2% as the captain and 33.4% in a FLEX spot.

Cowboys vs Eagles DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Cowboys vs Eagles DraftKings Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 18.5%, ahead of Javonte Williams (13.8%) and Dak Prescott (13.1%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Cowboys vs Eagles?

Build around CeeDee Lamb at captain with Dak Prescott, Tanner McKee and Dallas Goedert at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (249 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $8,100 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Cowboys vs Eagles DraftKings Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb leads the SPAGS model at 18.6 DraftKings points for $11,000 at FLEX, or 27.8 points at captain for $16,500.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Cowboys vs Eagles Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb is the most expensive player at $11,000 FLEX and $16,500 at captain. All 27 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Cowboys vs Eagles DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Darius Cooper (8.4 points at $3,200), Makai Lemon (9.4 points at $3,800) and Ryan Flournoy (8.7 points at $5,000).

What is the Cowboys vs Eagles spread and total?

The Cowboys are a 4.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 43.5, with implied team totals of 24 for the Cowboys and 19.5 for the Eagles.
